verdict.rationale: LangSmith Engine is documented as automatically detecting recurring issues in traces, diagnosing root cause, and helping resolve them. That is in-product insight and suggestion generation from the user's own data, but it rests on a single short docs line that doesn't describe how it works. LLM-as-judge evaluators score outputs, which is related but is not insight generation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how Engine generates insights or suggestions (AI/LLM basis, output format, workflow), evidence of natural-language summaries or recommendations over dashboards and traces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Automatically detect recurring issues in your traces, diagnose their root cause, and resolve them with LangSmith Engine.
